## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (2)
- `GET /_next/static/{staticToken}/{staticToken}` — Fetch static assets during authentication.
- `POST /sessions/{sessionId}` — Create or manage a user session.

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /attribution_trigger` — Trigger attribution tracking.
- `GET /organizations/{organizationId}/routing` — Get routing information for an organization.
- `GET /v1/onelink` — Resolve a OneLink URL.

### Data Write (4)
- `POST /{id}` — Update data associated with an ID.
- `POST /api/v1/p` — Post data to the /api/v1/p endpoint.
- `POST /v1/{v1Id}` — Update data associated with a V1 ID.
- `POST /wa/` — Send a message via the WA API.

### Config (2)
- `GET /v1/config/{configHash}` — Retrieve a specific configuration.
- `GET /v2/recaptchaConfig` — Get reCAPTCHA configuration.

## Quick Start

Here's a Quick Start guide to get you interacting with the Replit API. These examples demonstrate common read and write operations using a hypothetical `client` object.

```typescript
// Example: Retrieving organization routing information.
async function getOrganizationRouting(organizationId: string) {
  try {
    const routingInfo = await client.organizations[organizationId].routing();
    console.log("Organization Routing Info:", routingInfo);
    return routingInfo;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to retrieve organization routing:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Replit's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Replit data without official API access
- Automate actions on replit.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Replit frontend uses
